Title: Bulk invoice export
Details: Finance users can export all invoices of a month as one ZIP file from the Billing page.

Title: Fix duplicate charge on retry
Details: Retrying a failed card payment no longer creates a second charge.

Title: Remove legacy search API v1
Details: The v1 search endpoint is gone. Clients must call v2 search with the new query parameter.

Title: Faster result paging
Details: Paging through 10000 results is now three times faster.

Title: Fix crash when pasting images
Details: Pasting an image larger than 5 MB no longer closes the editor.

Title: Refactor autosave module
Details: Internal cleanup of the autosave code, no visible change.

Title: Dark mode for comments
Details: Comments now follow the dark theme.

Title: Rename plan field tier to plan_tier
Details: The API field tier in invoice responses is now plan_tier. Update your integrations.
